name: Gray-cheeked Parakeet
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of western ecuador and far northwestern peru
description: Small parakeet, fairly common within very limited range in southwest Ecuador and barely into extreme northwest Peru. Overall lime-green with pale gray head and sky-blue crown.

name: Rennell Starling
rangeDescription: Rennell and bellona (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A medium-sized, uniformly black starling with a glossy purplish-bluish sheen and a short tail. Bill is relatively thick and stubby.

name: Japanese Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Incompletely known; breeds japan (honshu, shikoku, and kyushu); winter range uncertain
description: Small songbird, a member of the Arctic Warbler complex, this species looks essentially identical to Arctic Warbler and Kamchatka Leaf Warbler but is more evenly yellowish. Normally only distinguished in the field by breeding range and song: breeds in forests on all of the main Japanese islands except Hokkaido, where it is replaced in summer by Kamchatka Leaf Warbler.

name: Murphy's Petrel
rangeDescription: Tuamotu archipelago, austral islands, and pitcairn island
description: A mainly gray or grayish brown petrel with a relatively heavy and pronounced forebody and more slender rear. Very pale faced with a relatively small, weak bill and indistinct brownish ‘M’ across back and wings.

name: Arabian Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Mountains of southwestern arabia
description: Handsome chunky gray-brown finch with a massive dark bill. Brown hood, white ear-patches, and brightly contrasting golden stripes in the dark wings and tail make this an easily recognizable species.

name: Bolivian Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern peru (huánuco to puno) to western bolivia
description: Small, pale olive-gray flycatcher. Found across a wide elevational range from montane forest all the way up to elfin forest and scrub around the treeline.

name: Black-faced Hawk
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to southern venezuela, northeastern ecuador, and northern amazonian brazil
description: Smallish chunky hawk. Identifiable by size, shape, and prominent black mask contrasting with orange cere.

name: Wahlberg's Eagle
rangeDescription: Savanna of sub-saharan africa
description: A small brown eagle with a slighter head and weaker beak than in larger brown eagles. A short crest gives the head a distinct squared-off look.

name: Hook-billed Bulbul
rangeDescription: Lowland forest of borneo, eastern sumatra, and bangka island
description: A highly localized species, found almost exclusively in the kerangas and peatswamp forests of Borneo and Sumatra’s lowlands (rarely in adjacent wooded habitats). Fairly plain overall; note brown upperparts, off-white chest, pale yellow belly, and elegant white eyebrow.

name: Chestnut-bellied Malkoha
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar, southern thailand, malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Large, rather ungainly cuckoo; clambers about in the middle and upper levels of lowland forests and edges as it forages. Glossy green above, gray below and on head, with neon-orange skin around the eye, chestnut-orange belly and undertail coverts, greenish-yellow bill, and white-tipped green tail.

name: Masked Cardinal
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia (southward to northern meta and eastern vichada), venezuela (except far southern) and trinidad
description: Unmistakable tricolored bird, with bold red, black, and white patches. Red hood and throat, black mask, mostly black back and tail, and white underparts.

name: Eastern Long-tailed Hornbill
rangeDescription: Benin through congo basin to western uganda and northern angola
description: A small-bodied hornbill with an extremely long tail, a dark bill, and a puffy white crest. Usually found in thick rainforest, where it can be difficult to view.

name: Baudin's Black-Cockatoo
rangeDescription: Far southwestern australia (south of the murchison river)
description: Black cockatoo with white ear patch and white tail panel. Inhabits moist eucalypt forest in the southwestern corner of Western Australia, where it eats seeds from large seed pods of Marri and Karri trees.

name: Noronha Elaenia
rangeDescription: Ilha fernando de noronha (off northeastern brazil)
description: The only flycatcher on the island of Fernando de Noronha. Olive-brown above, paler below, with three white wingbars.

name: Black-ringed White-eye
rangeDescription: Hills of southwestern sulawesi
description: A small green-backed songbird with a broad black eye patch, a yellow throat and base to undertail, and a white belly. Pairs and small groups can be found in the understory and canopy of forest, forest edge, and scrubby areas in both lowlands and foothills.

name: Sumichrast's Wren
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southern mexico (veracruz, puebla, and adjacent northern oaxaca)
description: Very local in humid evergreen forest of limestone (karst) lowlands and foothills in northern Oaxaca and adjacent Veracruz; endemic. Stays on or near the ground, moving quickly among limestone boulders, popping in and out of caves and crevices.

name: Ryukyu Minivet
rangeDescription: Southern kyushu and ryukyu islands (southern japan)
description: Medium-sized, slender songbird, dark above, white below; rather large for a minivet. Male has white forecrown and brow, lacking in female.

name: Tufted Puffin
rangeDescription: Coasts and islands of northeastern asia to aleutians and southern california
description: The largest puffin, this chunky seabird has an entirely black body, white face, and fetching tuft of yellowish feathers curling around its nape. Thick orange bill and orange feet.

name: Drongo Fantail
rangeDescription: Montane forest of new guinea including yule island
description: A medium-sized bird of forest interior, from the foothill to the mid-mountains. An all-black bird with bluish gloss, long tail, flattened crown and hooked bill.

name: Jackson's Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Montane forest of western and central kenya
description: Large, chunky brown francolin with a red bill, red legs, and bare red skin around the eye. Found in montane forest, forest edge, moorland, and grassland.
